targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', f.created_at)::date AS "periodo",
  'Ingresos (Facturas)' AS "tipo",
  SUM(COALESCE(f.total::numeric, 0)) AS "monto"
FROM facturas f
WHERE f.created_at >= '2025-01-01'
  AND f.estado_pago != 'ANULADA'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', f.created_at)
UNION ALL
SELECT
  date_trunc('month', mt.fecha)::date AS "periodo",
  CASE WHEN mt.tipo = 'EGRESO' THEN 'Gastos (Tesorería)' ELSE 'Ingresos (Tesorería)' END AS "tipo",
  SUM(mt.monto::numeric) AS "monto"
FROM movimientos_tesoreria mt
WHERE mt.fecha >= '2025-01-01'
  AND mt.tipo IN ('INGRESO', 'EGRESO')
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', mt.fecha), mt.tipo
ORDER BY 1, 2;

WITH ingresos AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total::numeric), 0) AS total
  FROM facturas
  WHERE created_at >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
    AND estado_pago != 'ANULADA'
),
gastos AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(monto::numeric), 0) AS total
  FROM movimientos_tesoreria
  WHERE fecha >= date_trunc('month', CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '1 month')
    AND tipo = 'EGRESO'
)
SELECT
  'Ingresos' AS concepto,
  (SELECT total FROM ingresos) AS monto
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Gastos', (SELECT total FROM gastos)
UNION ALL
SELECT 'Resultado', (SELECT total FROM ingresos) - (SELECT total FROM gastos);

SELECT COALESCE(SUM(saldo_pendiente::numeric), 0) AS "cuentas_por_cobrar"
FROM facturas
WHERE estado_pago IN ('PENDIENTE', 'PARCIAL')
  AND sifen_status != 'RECHAZADO';

SELECT estado_pago, COUNT(*)::int AS count
FROM facturas
GROUP BY estado_pago
ORDER BY count DESC;

SELECT
  to_char(date_trunc('month', created_at), 'YYYY-MM') AS mes,
  SUM(total::numeric) AS total_facturado
FROM facturas
WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '12 months'
  AND estado_pago != 'ANULADA'
GROUP BY date_trunc('month', created_at)
ORDER BY 1;

SELECT
  cb.nombre AS "Cuenta",
  CASE
    WHEN cb.tipo = 'CAJA_FISICA' THEN 'Caja Física'
    WHEN cb.tipo = 'CTA_CTE' THEN 'Cta. Cte.'
    WHEN cb.tipo = 'CAJA_AHORRO' THEN 'Caja Ahorro'
    WHEN cb.tipo = 'BILLETERA_DIGITAL' THEN 'Billetera Digital'
    ELSE cb.tipo
  END AS "Tipo",
  cb.moneda AS "Moneda",
  cb.saldo_actual::numeric AS "Saldo Actual",
  cb.banco AS "Banco"
FROM cuentas_bancarias cb
WHERE cb.activo = true
ORDER BY cb.saldo_actual::numeric DESC;

SELECT
  date_trunc('day', mt.fecha)::date AS fecha,
  CASE
    WHEN mt.tipo = 'INGRESO' THEN 'Ingresos'
    WHEN mt.tipo = 'EGRESO' THEN 'Egresos'
    WHEN mt.tipo = 'TRANSFERENCIA' THEN 'Transferencias'
    ELSE mt.tipo
  END AS tipo,
  SUM(mt.monto::numeric) AS monto
FROM movimientos_tesoreria mt
WHERE mt.fecha >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '30 days'
GROUP BY date_trunc('day', mt.fecha), mt.tipo
ORDER BY 1, 2;

SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN medio_pago = 'EFECTIVO' THEN 'Efectivo'
    WHEN medio_pago = 'TRANSFERENCIA' THEN 'Transferencia'
    WHEN medio_pago = 'CHEQUE' THEN 'Cheque'
    WHEN medio_pago = 'TARJETA_DEBITO' THEN 'Tarjeta Débito'
    WHEN medio_pago = 'TARJETA_CREDITO' THEN 'Tarjeta Crédito'
    ELSE medio_pago
  END AS medio_pago,
  SUM(monto::numeric) AS total
FROM movimientos_tesoreria
WHERE fecha >= CURRENT_DATE - INTERVAL '6 months'
GROUP BY medio_pago
ORDER BY total DESC;

SELECT
  f.numero_factura_manual AS "Factura",
  f.total::numeric AS "Total",
  f.saldo_pendiente::numeric AS "Saldo Pendiente",
  to_char(f.fecha_vencimiento::date, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS "Vencimiento",
  (CURRENT_DATE - f.fecha_vencimiento::date)::int AS "Días Vencido"
FROM facturas f
WHERE f.estado_pago IN ('PENDIENTE', 'PARCIAL')
  AND f.fecha_vencimiento < CURRENT_DATE
ORDER BY f.fecha_vencimiento ASC;

panels.title: Plan de Cuentas — Saldos por Tipo

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN pc.tipo = 'ACTIVO' THEN 'Activos'
    WHEN pc.tipo = 'PASIVO' THEN 'Pasivos'
    WHEN pc.tipo = 'PATRIMONIO' THEN 'Patrimonio'
    WHEN pc.tipo = 'INGRESO' THEN 'Ingresos'
    WHEN pc.tipo = 'GASTO' THEN 'Gastos'
    WHEN pc.tipo = 'COSTO' THEN 'Costos'
    ELSE pc.tipo
  END AS tipo_cuenta,
  COALESCE(SUM(ad.haber::numeric) - SUM(ad.debe::numeric), 0) AS saldo
FROM plan_cuentas pc
LEFT JOIN asientos_detalle ad ON ad.cuenta_id = pc.id
LEFT JOIN asientos_contables ac ON ac.id = ad.asiento_id AND ac.estado = 'CONTABILIZADO'
GROUP BY pc.tipo
ORDER BY 2 DESC;
